item.title: WLUD Community Radio Update!
item.description: A lot is still happening behind the scenes to get WLUD community radio off the ground. In March 2027, WLUD will need to be broadcasting locally on 93.3 FM, and we know we want to be streaming online well before then, so that we can get the operational workflow down, and have time to get the programming in order, show hosts & DJs trained, and all of the other things that will inevitably come up. item.title: We're Under Construction!
item.description: We're thrilled to announce that construction has begun on our next phase of renovations! However, we are not able to hold our regular open hours during this time. For anyone looking to make an appointment, please contact us. You can find that information on our Info page . The renovation project is scheduled to be completed by mid-April, at which time we will open back up with our regular hours. For more information on the project & what exactly is being done, check it out here .
